mLocKeys.keySummary: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Azir grants himself @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies he passes through.

If Azir hits an enemy champion, he stops and gains a Sand Soldier charge.

mBuff.mDescription:
Shurima's LegacyAzir can summon the Sun Disc from the ruins of a turret once every @f1@ seconds. This turret gains @f3@ bonus attack damage and disintegrates over @f2@ seconds.

Click the ruins of a turret to activate Shurima's Legacy. The ruins of enemy Nexus and Inhibitor turrets are immune to this ability.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Azir can summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Azir can summon the <keywordMajor>Sun Disc</keywordMajor> from the rubble of a turret. The <keywordMajor>Sun Disc</keywordMajor> deals <magicDamage>@TowerDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and has @BonusResists@ <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> but disintegrates over @TowerDisintegrationTime@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_AzirPassive_Tooltip}}

You may not target enemy Nexus and Inhibitor Turrets with this Ability.
Sun Disk loses 100 Armor and Magic Resist if you are dead or too far away.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Disc of the Sun</titleLeft><mainText>Azir is ready to raise Shurima from the ruins. He can summon the Sun Disc from a destroyed turret.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Conquering Sands</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by Azir's Conquering Sands.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Azir orders all <keywordMajor>Sand Soldiers</keywordMajor> to an area, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies they pass through and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmount*-100@% for 1 second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Enemies hit by multiple <keywordMajor>Sand Soldiers</keywordMajor> will not take additional damage.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Azir summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Azir summons a wall of armored soldiers that charges forward, <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The soldiers remain, blocking enemy paths for @WallDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Emperor's Divide</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is being Knocked Back by Emperor's Divide.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Decisive Command</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has massively increased attack speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Azir summons a Sand Soldier for @SoldierDuration@ seconds. When Azir Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, he instead orders the soldiers to stab, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage in their direction.

This Ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Sand Soldiers apply On-hits at @OnHitMultiplier*100@% damage once per attack to Azir's primary target.
Sand Soldiers that strike the same targets deal @SubsequentDamageMod@% damage after the first.
Sand Soldiers deal @SecondaryTargetDamageMod@% damage to enemies that are not Azir's Attack target.
Sand Soldiers expire twice as fast when near an enemy turret.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Decisive Command</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has massively increased attack speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
